signature: discover_and_prove(expr: str, fn: Callable[[int], int], check_upto: int = 60, judge_timeout_ms: int = 2500) -> ArithmeticFinding
requires: expr is a univariate integer polynomial in n accepted by the exact kernel bridge and fn computes that polynomial over integer inputs.
check_upto and judge_timeout_ms retain their existing positive bounded meanings.
The immutable legacy baseline and committed discovery SAMPLE-REPORT remain differential oracles.
ensures: Exact normalized polynomial degree selects the portfolio before timing-sensitive work: degree four or greater uses complete residue exhaustion directly; lower degree retains the induction and CRT-first path with an honest residue fallback.
In POLY_FAMILY order the canonical methods are induction, modulus-factoring, residue-exhaustion, induction, modulus-factoring, residue-exhaustion, residue-exhaustion on every supported host.
High-degree canonical laws do not change certainty, method, reason, proof hash, or rendered bytes when host speed changes.
Every proved finding remains independently checked and kernel verified; strategy selection never upgrades incomplete evidence.
The committed discovery SAMPLE-REPORT is byte-identical to a fresh render across the supported matrix.
raises: Inputs outside the required integer-polynomial domain retain the existing parser, kernel, or arithmetic error boundary.
MemoryError, KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit, and interpreter defects are not converted into proof outcomes.
A failed independent or kernel check cannot be represented as verified.

effects.process: none beyond existing in-process solver calls on the low-degree path
effects.cache: run_arithmetic_discovery may retain returned findings; strategy selection has no cache
effects.mutation: does not mutate inputs, contracts, generated reports, trackers, or frozen evidence

determinism.degree: len(poly_from_sympy(expr)) minus one after exact coefficient normalization
determinism.high_degree: degree at least four selects residue-exhaustion before any solver call
determinism.canonical_methods: induction, modulus-factoring, residue-exhaustion, induction, modulus-factoring, residue-exhaustion, residue-exhaustion
determinism.excluded_inputs: elapsed time, host speed, architecture, checkout path, and solver scheduling never select the high-degree strategy

budget.refutation: at most check_upto plus one exact fn evaluations before proof selection
budget.high_degree: at most modulus exact residue evaluations and zero induction solver calls
budget.low_degree: existing bounded induction calls use judge_timeout_ms per prime-power part before fallback
budget.memory: bounded by polynomial coefficients, prime-power parts, and at most modulus residue results

epistemics.proved: a complete universal proof was independently checked and a kernel proof term was minted
epistemics.refuted: an exact integer input violates the divisibility claim
epistemics.unknown: bounded proof work did not establish the claim and no complete fallback established it
epistemics.method: names the deterministically selected checked strategy rather than a timing race

invariants: No wall-clock race or solver timeout changes the canonical discovery report.
No method label claims stronger evidence than was checked.
The seven canonical proof hashes and axiom lists remain unchanged.
No matrix cell, test, profile command, or coverage threshold is removed or weakened.
Accepted contracts and frozen legacy evidence remain byte-identical.
